name: Enable DNS over HTTPS (DoH)
description: Enables encrypted DNS resolution for active servers using public providers like Cloudflare and Google, ensuring secure name lookups without increasing internet speed.

description_i18n.en: Enables encrypted DNS resolution for active servers using public providers like Cloudflare and Google, ensuring secure name lookups without increasing internet speed.
description_i18n.de: Aktiviert die verschlüsselte Namensauflösung für aktive Server mit öffentlichen Anbietern wie Cloudflare und Google, um sichere Lookups zu gewährleisten ohne Internetgeschwindigkeit zu erhöhen.
description_i18n.fr: Active la résolution DNS chiffrée pour les serveurs actifs en utilisant des fournisseurs publics comme Cloudflare et Google, assurant une sécurité sans augmenter la vitesse.

warnings.title: Network behavior change
warnings.message: DNS queries will be routed through HTTPS connections for supported servers instead of standard UDP/TCP ports. This does not increase raw internet speed but changes how names are resolved

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Configures the DoHTemplate and AutoUpgrade settings for all active IPv4 DNS servers listed in known public providers Applies changes to existing server addresses without modifying fallback protocols or disabling other network features
